root_idea.summary: The root centers on cyclical movement or coursing, especially through water, and is associated with the annual cycle expressed by عَامٌ.
root_idea.development: The physical sense of swimming or coursing is connected in the lexical tradition with the sun's passage through its celestial stations; عَامٌ consequently denotes a complete annual cycle, conventionally distinguished from سَنَةٌ as a period containing winter and summer.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested group is presented under the normalized nominal citation form عَامٌ.

senses.definition: A year; a complete annual period.
senses.usage_conditions: A temporal noun often synonymous with سَنَةٌ or حَوْلٌ. Lexical usage can distinguish it as the cycle comprising a winter and a summer, while ordinary Quranic contexts use it for a counted year or years.

senses.definition: A year of prosperity, fertility, and relief.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran-focused contrast with سَنَةٌ, which is often associated with hardship or drought, عَامٌ can designate a favorable and fruitful year, especially in the expression describing the year in which people receive rain and press produce.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To swim or course along in water; of ships, to sail or float; by extension, of stars to course through the sky and of camels to travel across the desert.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The extensions retain the idea of sustained movement through a medium or expanse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a ship swim or float.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form II construction with a ship as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn or twist a turban upon the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional Form II use applied to the arrangement of a turban.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The placing of reaped corn in handfuls.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived-noun use referring to the arrangement of harvested grain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hire or engage someone for a year, or to make a yearly contract for work or a similar service.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction denotes an agreement measured by the year.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A transaction extending across multiple years, especially selling the future produce or fruit of trees for two or more years, or extending and increasing a debt after it falls due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the transaction called مُعَاوَمَةٌ in the discussion of prohibited or disapproved dealings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a palm tree: to bear in one year and not in another; of a grapevine: to bear much one year and little the next.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agricultural use describing alternating or markedly unequal yearly production.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a palm tree, to complete a year of growth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A use referring to the completion of an elapsed year rather than to a contractual period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a dwelling, to become altered or weathered as years pass over it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV use describing the visible effects of the passage of years on a dwelling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In temporal expressions, a former year, a year before the present one, or some years ago.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This conventional use appears with expressions such as عَامٌ أَوَّلُ, عَامُ الأَوَّلِ, and related phrases involving a period of years.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A float, raft, or small ferry used for crossing water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be made from branches or similar materials and may toss about on the water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The head of a ruler or camel-rider when it appears at a distance in an open desert.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may be applied especially when the head is seen with a turban.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A turn or twist of a turban.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use for one arrangement or winding of the turban.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A quantity of reaped corn placed in handfuls.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an ordinary noun for a grouped portion of harvested grain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small smooth, round aquatic insect that swims in water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical description compares its shape and dark appearance to the stone of a ring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of serpent found in Oman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional zoological designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A year old or having had a year pass over it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a plant, it can mean a year old and therefore dry; applied to a dwelling trace, it means that a year has passed over it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a colocynth, associated with or useful in a year of drought or barrenness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use referring to its preparation or usefulness during a drought year.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person skilled in swimming; figuratively, a horse fleet or excellent in running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The second application extends the image of vigorous arm-and-leg movement from swimming to running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Swimming or coursing along; of ships, sailing or floating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle is used of a swimmer and, by extension, of ships moving on water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Severe, seemingly long years caused by drought or barrenness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression in which the years are described as if they were prolonged by the hardship they bring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a certain idol of the Arabs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name use distinct from the active participle meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a grapevine, bearing in one year and not in the next.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural adjective describing alternate-year bearing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fat characterized as being from one year after another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic description of fat in relation to successive years.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ship upon the sea.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal designation for a vessel at sea.

A Quranic expression mentioned in the swimming discussion is retained only as lexical context. Its historical citation is not converted into a modern verse location or assigned to the QAC noun عام.
